verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de mu oyan rọye phihọ, o de rhi te otọ rẹ ihwo rẹ ọnre da vacha
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de mu oyan roye phiho o de rhi te oto re ihwo re onre da vacha

verses.text_urhobo: Rọ vwọ kpare opharo, ọ da mrẹ orhare vwẹ evun rẹ ẹghwa, o vwo ni, ekru rẹ igodẹ erha rhuẹn kẹrẹ; kidie ame rẹ orhare na ọye igodẹ na da. Oragha rọ unu rọye na pha rhuarho,
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo kpare opharo o da mre orhare vwe evun re eghwa o vwo ni ekru re igode erha rhuen kere kidie ame re orhare na oye igode na da oragha ro unu roye na pha rhuarho

verses.text_urhobo: ọke rẹ ekru rẹ uchuru na rhi vwo si koko, isuigodẹ na ki ghorie oragha na nẹ unu rẹ orhare na, igodẹ na ke da ame, ayen, Me rha vwẹ oragha na rhurhu unu rẹ orhare na.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ekru re uchuru na rhi vwo si koko isuigode na ki ghorie oragha na ne unu re orhare na igode na ke da ame ayen me rha vwe oragha na rhurhu unu re orhare na

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta kẹ ayen, Iniọvo mẹ, tivọ we nurhe? Ayen da ta, Haran avwanre nurhe.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ke ayen iniovo me tivo we nurhe ayen da ta haran avwanre nurhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ovwan riẹn Laban rẹ ọmọ ri Nahọr? Ayen da ta, Avwanre riẹnrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen ovwan rien laban re omo ri nahor ayen da ta avwanre rienre

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Oma rọye dori? Ayen da ta, O dori; nighere, Rachel rẹ ọmọtẹ rọye vẹ igodẹ re gba yan usun cha na;
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen oma roye dori ayen da ta o dori nighere rachel re omote roye ve igode re gba yan usun cha na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Nighe, ọke je herọ, o ji te ọke re vwo si eranvwe koko-o, jẹ igodẹ na da ame, rere wọ vwẹ ayen yanran ra re odi.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta nighe oke je hero o ji te oke re vwo si eranvwe koko o je igode na da ame rere wo vwe ayen yanran ra re odi

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ayen da ta, Avwanre sa yanran jokpa nẹ igodẹ na ejobi kokori, re de rhe ghorie ubioragha na nẹ unu rẹ orhare na; tavwe igodẹ na ke da ame.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ayen da ta avwanre sa yanran jokpa ne igode na ejobi kokori re de rhe ghorie ubioragha na ne unu re orhare na tavwe igode na ke da ame

verses.text_urhobo: Rọ je vwọ ta ota na kẹ ayen na, Rachel vẹ igodẹ rẹ ọsẹ rọye da yan rhe, fikiridie ọye re sẹro rẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: ro je vwo ta ota na ke ayen na rachel ve igode re ose roye da yan rhe fikiridie oye re sero re ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Jekọp vwọ mrẹ Rachel rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Laban rẹ oniọvo rẹ oni rọye, kugbe igodẹ ri Laban rẹ oniọvo rẹ oni rọye, Jekọp da yanran re ghorie oragha na nẹ unu rẹ orhare na, ọ da vwẹ ame kẹ igodẹ ri Laban oniọvo rẹ oni rọye da.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri jekop vwo mre rachel re omote ri laban re oniovo re oni roye kugbe igode ri laban re oniovo re oni roye jekop da yanran re ghorie oragha na ne unu re orhare na o da vwe ame ke igode ri laban oniovo re oni roye da

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da fiọnfiọn unu ri Rachel, ọ da viẹ phia.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da fionfion unu ri rachel o da vie phia

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta ki Rachel nẹ ọye omoni rẹ ọsẹ rọye, nẹ ọye ọmọ ri Rebeka; o de ghwe vrẹn ra vuẹ ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ki rachel ne oye omoni re ose roye ne oye omo ri rebeka o de ghwe vren ra vue ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Laban vwo nyo ikun ri Jekọp ọmọ rẹ oniọvo rọye, ọ da djẹ ra vwa, ọ da gbanọ, ọ da fiọnfiọn unu, ọ da reyọ kpo uwevwi rọye Jekọp de gbe ikun nana ejobi ki Laban.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri laban vwo nyo ikun ri jekop omo re oniovo roye o da dje ra vwa o da gbano o da fionfion unu o da reyo kpo uwevwi roye jekop de gbe ikun nana ejobi ki laban

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da ta kẹ, Omuẹro wẹ ubeku rẹ oma mẹ kugbe uvwo rẹ oma mẹ; Ọ da dia uwevwi rọye emeravwe ọvo.
verses.text_romanized: laban da ta ke omuero we ubeku re oma me kugbe uvwo re oma me o da dia uwevwi roye emeravwe ovo

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Laban da ta ki Jekọp, fikiridie wọ vwọ omoni mẹ na, ku wọ de ga vwẹ ọphọphẹ? Ta kẹ vwẹ, bro osa Me hwa kẹ wẹ?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin laban da ta ki jekop fikiridie wo vwo omoni me na ku wo de ga vwe ophophe ta ke vwe bro osa me hwa ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena Laban vwo emetẹ ivẹ, odẹ rẹ oro ọkpako Leah, odẹ rẹ ọro otete ki Rachel.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena laban vwo emete ive ode re oro okpako leah ode re oro otete ki rachel

verses.text_urhobo: Ibiẹro ri Leah pha rhukpu rhukpu, ẹkẹvuọvo ọ ri Rachel pha sasasa yoyovwi.
verses.text_romanized: ibiero ri leah pha rhukpu rhukpu ekevuovo o ri rachel pha sasasa yoyovwi

verses.text_urhobo: Rachel kọye je Jekọp; ọ da ta, Me ga we ikpe ighwrẹ fiki ri Rachel rẹ ọmọtẹ wẹn rẹ otete na;
verses.text_romanized: rachel koye je jekop o da ta me ga we ikpe ighwre fiki ri rachel re omote wen re otete na

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da ta, Ofori re Me vwọ kẹ wẹ nọ ọ re Me da vwọ kẹ ohwo ọfa; nene uvwe dia.
verses.text_romanized: laban da ta ofori re me vwo ke we no o re me da vwo ke ohwo ofa nene uvwe dia

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da ga ẹga ikpe ighwrẹ fiki ri Rachel, e da họhọ ẹdẹ tutuno vwọ kẹ kidie o jere gangan.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da ga ega ikpe ighwre fiki ri rachel e da hoho ede tutuno vwo ke kidie o jere gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da ta ki Laban, Kẹ vwẹ aye mẹ rere Me vẹ ọye vwerhẹ, kidie ẹdẹ na gbare.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da ta ki laban ke vwe aye me rere me ve oye vwerhe kidie ede na gbare

verses.text_urhobo: Laban de se ihwo rẹ asan na koko, o de chere emu kẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: laban de se ihwo re asan na koko o de chere emu ke ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo rẹ ovwọnvwọn vwo te ọ da reyọ Leah o de suo rhe Jekọp, o de bro kpo ovwerhẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo re ovwonvwon vwo te o da reyo leah o de suo rhe jekop o de bro kpo ovwerhe

verses.text_urhobo: (Laban da vwẹ ayeobọ rọye Milkah vwọ kẹ Leah ro nene dia).
verses.text_romanized: laban da vwe ayeobo roye milkah vwo ke leah ro nene dia

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ irhiọke, o vwo ni, ki Leah, Jekọp da ta kẹ Laban, Ọna didi emu wo ru kẹ vwẹ na? O dia fiki ri Rachel Me vwọ ga wẹ? Komavọ wọ rha vwọ phiẹn vwẹ?
verses.text_romanized: vwe irhioke o vwo ni ki leah jekop da ta ke laban ona didi emu wo ru ke vwe na o dia fiki ri rachel me vwo ga we komavo wo rha vwo phien vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da ta, E ruẹ ọtiọye vwẹ orho rẹ avwanre-e, a ka vwẹ omotete brọgọ je ọkpako otọ-ọ.
verses.text_romanized: laban da ta e rue otioye vwe orho re avwanre e a ka vwe omotete brogo je okpako oto o

verses.text_urhobo: Ru ẹdẹ rẹ ọna gba, avwanre kẹ vwẹ ọrivẹ na kẹ wẹ wọ da ga vwẹ ikpe ighwrẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: ru ede re ona gba avwanre ke vwe orive na ke we wo da ga vwe ikpe ighwre efa

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de ghine ru ọtiọye, o de ru ẹdẹ na gba, Etiyin Laban da vwi Rachel kẹ vwọ rọvwọ
verses.text_romanized: jekop de ghine ru otioye o de ru ede na gba etiyin laban da vwi rachel ke vwo rovwo

verses.text_urhobo: (Laban da vwẹ ayeobọ rọye Bilhah vwọ kẹ Rachel rẹ ọmọtẹ rọye).
verses.text_romanized: laban da vwe ayeobo roye bilhah vwo ke rachel re omote roye

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Jekọp de bru Rachel kpo ovwerhẹ, ivun ri Rachel da vwerhọ vwọ nọ Leah, ọ da rhoma ga Laban ikpe ighwrẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: koye jekop de bru rachel kpo ovwerhe ivun ri rachel da vwerho vwo no leah o da rhoma ga laban ikpe ighwre efa

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwọ mrẹ nẹ ivun ri Leah sa vwerhe Jekọp te-e, o de rhie urhoro rẹ emọ kẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo Rachel kẹ ẹga.
verses.text_romanized: oke re orovwohwo vwo mre ne ivun ri leah sa vwerhe jekop te e o de rhie urhoro re emo ke ekevuovo rachel ke ega

verses.text_urhobo: Leah da mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare o de se odẹ rọye Rubẹn kidie ọ tare nẹ, Ọrovwohwo mrẹ olagha mẹ, omuẹro ivun mẹ kọ vwerhe ọshare mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: leah da mrevun o de vwie omoshare o de se ode roye ruben kidie o tare ne orovwohwo mre olagha me omuero ivun me ko vwerhe oshare me

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da rhoma mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare, ọ da ta, kidie Ọrovwohwo nyori ni mi tuoma, ọye ọ vwọ rhoma kẹ vwẹ ọmọshare; o de se odẹ rọye Simiọn.
verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma mrevun o de vwie omoshare o da ta kidie orovwohwo nyori ni mi tuoma oye o vwo rhoma ke vwe omoshare o de se ode roye simion

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da rhoma mrevun ọfa o de vwiẹ ọmọshare, ọ da ta, Kẹ etinẹ yanran ọshare mẹ kọ vwẹ oma te vwe, kidie mi vwiẹ emeshare erha kẹ re, ọtiọye na o de se odẹ rọye Livae.
verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma mrevun ofa o de vwie omoshare o da ta ke etine yanran oshare me ko vwe oma te vwe kidie mi vwie emeshare erha ke re otioye na o de se ode roye livae

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rhoma mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare, ọ da ta, Vwẹ ọke nana ki mi jiri Ọrovwohwo; fiki rẹ ọtiọye na o de se odẹ rọye Juda, o de bru uvwiẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o rhoma mrevun o de vwie omoshare o da ta vwe oke nana ki mi jiri orovwohwo fiki re otioye na o de se ode roye juda o de bru uvwie

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp ga Ẹga ri Rachel kugbe Leah ke Laban
headings.text_romanized: jekop ga ega ri rachel kugbe leah ke laban
